name: agent-nekko-workspace
description: Agent Nekko: your local agent, backed by frontier intelligence, with CLI/MCP integration and workflows.
author: ermish

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @agent-nekko/host && npm run build --workspace=apps/cli && npm run build -w @agent-nekko/desktop
scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @agent-nekko/shared && npm run build -w @agent-nekko/core
scripts.build:web: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @agent-nekko/host && npm run build --workspace=apps/cli && npm run build -w @agent-nekko/desktop && npm run build -w @agent-nekko/server && npm run build -w @agent-nekko/cloud
scripts.cloud: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @agent-nekko/host && npm run build -w @agent-nekko/desktop && npm run build -w @agent-nekko/cloud && npm run start -w @agent-nekko/cloud
scripts.local: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @agent-nekko/host && npm run build -w @agent-nekko/desktop && npm run start -w @agent-nekko/desktop
scripts.web: npm run build:web && npm run start -w @agent-nekko/server
scripts.bundle:web: npm run build:web && npm run bundle -w @agent-nekko/server
scripts.test: npm run test:brand && npm run test -w @agent-nekko/shared && npm run test -w @agent-nekko/core && npm run test -w @agent-nekko/desktop && npm run test -w @agent-nekko/cloud && npm run test -w @agent-nekko/host && npm run test -w @agent-nekko/server && npm run test -w @agent-nekko/relay && npm run test --workspace=apps/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w @agent-nekko/shared && npm run typecheck -w @agent-nekko/core && npm run typecheck -w @agent-nekko/host && npm run build --workspace=apps/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/cli && npm run typecheck -w @agent-nekko/desktop && npm run typecheck -w @agent-nekko/server && npm run typecheck -w @agent-nekko/relay && npm run typecheck -w @agent-nekko/cloud
scripts.relay: npm run build -w @agent-nekko/relay && npm run start -w @agent-nekko/relay
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @agent-nekko/desktop
